assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard electrocardiography.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The service is consistent with the clinical indication note.
The service supports medical necessity for the denied service under denial code PR-204.
